_note_timeliness: event_max_age_s: drop an event still queued after this many seconds (a slow model call made it stale). reply_max_age_s: discard a reply ready this long after the question instead of playing it; 0 = always play.
_note_model: deepseek-v4-flash-0731 is RECOMMENDED (cheap, JSON mode). Any OpenAI-compatible model that returns a JSON object and honours max_tokens works; put its id here. Switch later with install-model-switch.sh <id>.
_note_base_url: Your host's OpenAI-compatible base, with the /v1 suffix if the host uses one. Venice example: https://api.venice.ai/api/v1
_note_api_key: Supplied by you at install time (TWELVEACTORS_API_KEY=...), or edit this file after install. Never commit the real key.
